current_user_pool_override.precedence_rule: All prior 19-role requirements are stale only for pool membership, physical-enable, prompt-update, coverage and persistence denominators. All other safety, CLEAN, zero-Work, zero-quota, zero-cost, evidence, continuation and protected-primary constraints remain unchanged.

non_regression.rule: Preserve revision1 lifecycle budgets, bounded single-slice normal-return behavior, checkpoint/readback, no same-run wait/poll/backoff/retry, schedule staggering, same-task repair, prompt lifecycle alignment, persistence verification and all safety boundaries. Revision2 changes only current-pool membership semantics under the newer explicit self_improvement stop and adds a bounded process-only canary for two current roles that were observed physically disabled after runs with no durable output.

observations: Repeated stopped roles have reached physical disable near the platform invocation boundary and can leave no current durable receipt.
Surviving roles commonly return within the bounded lifecycle window.
Open Source revision 48 demonstrated a bounded artifact/checkpoint/LATEST/receipt chain and recurring-open return within the lifecycle envelope.
Bootstrap hard-boundary wording and same-run retry/polling were prior removable contributors.
Optimizer-last ordering reduces the interval a newly stopped current role remains disabled.

On 2026-09-04, failure_evidence and reasoning were both observed physically disabled despite enabled_desired=true and lifecycle-aligned prompts; their last scheduler starts had no subsequent durable receipt or role-state commit.
operational_conclusions: Crossing or approaching the platform boundary without a completed normal-return checkpoint remains a proven failure pattern.

When a role disables after a start with no durable output, later semantic-stage checkpoints cannot localize whether the run reached semantic bootstrap; the next method should move one process-only witness to the earliest lifecycle point rather than adding deeper semantic work.
If an early process-only witness also fails to appear, treat the remaining stop as a presemantic/platform-layer unresolved child and avoid speculative semantic-config churn.

per_invocation_contract.applies_to: all current 18 managed non-primary roles including the optimizer; explicitly user-stopped self_improvement and the protected O monitor are excluded
per_invocation_contract.clock_basis: elapsed time from actual automation invocation start when exposed; otherwise obey operation caps conservatively
required_order: Read and freeze current semantic controls plus this lifecycle overlay before substantive work, except the explicitly scoped process-only early canary below may occur after manifest plus lifecycle read and before semantic-control bodies.
Reconstruct only the exact role-local continuation needed for one highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf.
Attempt one direct bounded unit; do not expand into a second unit in the same invocation.
Reserve the checkpoint window before any action that could consume the remaining budget.
Persist and exact-readback the smallest role-valid artifact/checkpoint or diagnostic, current pointer when required, immutable own receipt when supported, and nonempty exact continuation.
Return normally before the absolute boundary with the recurring objective explicitly open.

final_chat_output.rule: After durable readback, emit only this noncompletion marker. Do not use completion, finished, done, no more work, or task-complete language while Phase 1 remains open.

forbidden: continue until a hard runtime/tool stop
consume the remaining invocation merely because more work exists
same-run backoff, polling, or repeated connector retries
waiting for CI, a remote job, or another worker
starting another optional leaf after the first durable slice
performing broad discovery after the checkpoint deadline
self-disabling or mutating physical scheduler state
treating a slice, receipt, checkpoint, no-change result, blocker or unavailable capability as role/root completion

early_zero_receipt_stop_canary.purpose: Localize repeated physical stops that left no durable post-start output, while consuming no semantic leaf and preserving CLEAN isolation.
order: Read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST.json and RUN_LIFECYCLE.json only, obtaining exact same-path identities under the manifest transport contract.

Before reading DESIRED_STATE, role-config semantic bodies, own semantic state, public sources, O, downstream or any other-role semantics, persist one compact immutable process-only receipt in this role's own receipt namespace and exact-read it back.

Receipt must contain role, task_id, repair_epoch, manifest path/revision/blob, RUN_LIFECYCLE path/revision/blob, canary=true, semantic_inputs_read=false, semantic_progress_claimed=false, global_completion=false, phase1_completion_claimed=false, enabled_desired=true, scheduler_mutation_by_worker=false, zero residual Work/protected/manual execution, zero finite quota, zero incremental cost, termination=lifecycle_entry_canary_recurring_open, and a nonempty continuation to perform the normal role bootstrap and one bounded Phase-1 semantic slice on the next recurrence.
After exact readback return immediately with ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. Do not read optional semantic inputs or perform a second leaf in the canary invocation.
early_zero_receipt_stop_canary.clean_boundary: The canary is process-only and may contain no O/downstream/other-worker semantics or scientific conclusions.
early_zero_receipt_stop_canary.success_interpretation: Canary receipt plus continued physical enablement proves the task reached Chat lifecycle bootstrap and can durably return before semantic work; next recurrence resumes the unchanged substantive role.
early_zero_receipt_stop_canary.failure_interpretation: If the task again becomes disabled and no canary receipt exists, classify the stop as presemantic/platform-layer unresolved. Re-enable the same task under user policy, preserve exact evidence, and do not speculate by weakening CLEAN or substantive role contracts.
early_zero_receipt_stop_canary.persistence_accounting: A readback-valid canary may count as a bounded scheduler-survival boundary but never as usefulness/scientific-output evidence; all independent Phase-1 usefulness gates still apply.

exception_paths.missing_capability: Record the exact missing surface and alternative-route child in one compact durable checkpoint, then normal-return recurring-open.
exception_paths.rate_limit_or_transient_connector_error: Do not sleep or retry in the same invocation. Persist the exact error, idempotency/CAS state and continuation, then normal-return recurring-open.
exception_paths.CAS_or_authority_mismatch: At most one immediate reread if still before the semantic soft stop; otherwise persist diagnostic continuation and normal-return. Never spin.
exception_paths.write_surface_failure: Prefer one compact role-local checkpoint/receipt over multiple outputs. If no safe write succeeds, emit a noncompletion diagnostic without claiming durable progress and retry next invocation.
exception_paths.already_completed_leaf: Record integration evidence if needed and immediately select no second leaf; persist next-leaf continuation for the next invocation and return.
exception_paths.blocked_leaf: Persist blocker and next alternative child; do not wait or restore unrelated base work during Phase 1.
